subject: Targeting Immune Microenvironments to Repair Torn Rotator Cuffs Beyond Mere Surgical Fixation
script: From Agewell Brief: Targeting Immune Microenvironments to Repair Torn Rotator Cuffs Beyond Mere Surgical Fixation. Human single-cell maps reveal why rotator cuff tears heal into stiff scar tissue rather than regenerating functional bone-tendon interfaces. Surgical anchors can successfully pin a torn tendon back to bone, yet biological healing frequently fails to reconstruct the native graded enthesis. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
